title: "Gameshow" Movie Theater
content: I've dreamt of various movie theaters or auditoriums before, but this one was different. In this one it was supposed to be a "movie theater" but everyone in the audience had collective input in what would happen next in the film via voting on phones/tablets. There were also games and ways to win prizes or money. Everything was extremely brightly colored. There were hallways that lead to airport gates, bathrooms with spiral ramps, and the movie theater lobby was inside a white tiled mall. I can specifically remember the faces of some of the people I was sitting next to, playing the games with. This is probably a longshot and not as descriptive as I would like. But wondering if anyone else has dreamt of a similar space. The other people there whose faces I remember just felt so... real
